caption:
Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges and annual reconciliations are a routine but often misunderstood part of commercial leasing. For investors, landlords, building owners, and business tenants in Chester County and Montgomery County, clarity on CAM definitions, allowable expenses, allocation methods, and audit rights prevents surprises. Review lease language for base years, caps, exclusions, and tenant responsibilities. Keep organized invoices, vendor contracts, and occupancy records; request a clear year-end reconciliation with supporting backup. Seasonal items like snow removal and landscaping can affect CAM lines, so confirm allocation methods. If disputes arise, use lease terms and documented backups to resolve them. We provide practical guidance to prepare for reconciliations, negotiate cleaner CAM clauses, and reduce long-term operating expense uncertainty for your building portfolio. Need a local CAM checklist or lease review? Go to dmsellscre.com/investors for resources and help.
